newsitem.title: UKRAINE: SOCCER-UKRAINE KEEP FAITH WITH SQUAD FOR GERMANY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UKRAINE KEEP FAITH WITH SQUAD FOR GERMANY.

text.p: Ukraine, the group nine leaders, named a little changed squad on Monday for their crucial World Cup qualifier against Germany in Kiev on June 7.

The Dynamo Kiev pair of Serhiy Rebrov, the country's top scorer, and Andrei Shevchenko are set to lead the attack again in a team showing few alterations from the side that dropped two precious points at home to Armenia on May 7.
Eleven of the 22 play for Dynamo Kiev, who won their fifth successive Ukrainian league title last week.
Group favourites Germany, who beat Ukraine 2-0 on April 30 in Bremen, trail by a point but have a game in hand. Portugal are third, three points behind Ukraine.
Goalkeepers - Oleg Suslov (Casino Graz, Austria), Oleksander Shovkovsky (Dynamo Kiev), Taras Grebenyuk (Metalurg Zaporizhya)

Defenders - Oleksander Golovko, Vladyslav Vashchuk, Yuri Dmytrulin, Serhiy Bezhenar, Oleg Luzhny (all Dynamo Kiev), Dmytro Parfyonov (Chornomorets Odessa), Oleksander Koval (Shakhtar Donetsk), Yuri Benyo (Karpaty Lviv).
Midfielders - Vitaly Kosovsky, Yuri Maximov, Yuri Kalivintsev, Dmytro Mikhaylenko (all Dynamo Kiev), Valery Kriventsov, Gennady Zubov, Serhiy Kovalyov (all Shakhtar Donetsk)
Forwards - Serhiy Rebrov, Andrei Shevchenko (both Dynamo Kiev), Serhiy Nagornyak (Dnipro Dnipropetrovsk), Timerlan Guseynov (Chornomorets Odessa).
